[1] STEERING OF ROAMING (SoR)
    -> Category: Roaming Management. High outbound/inbound/business-travel volumes identified. Mobileum AI-powered SoR optimises partner selection, reduces roaming costs, and increases revenue from roaming agreements. Key KPI: Roaming Revenue +15-25%.

[2] ROAMING CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Roaming Management. Strong roaming activity signals upsell opportunity. Targeted pre-trip alerts, roaming packs, and loyalty campaigns convert outbound subscribers into incremental revenue. Key KPI: Roaming Data Revenue +20%.

[3] ROAMING DNA (DPI-powered QoE Management)
    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] REVENUE & PROVISIONING ASSURANCE
    -> Category: Risk Management. Profitability pressure, flat/declining ARPU, or weak financials identified. Mobileum detects billing errors, provisioning mismatches, and service leakage to protect and recover margins. Key KPI: Revenue Recovery +2-5% of total revenue.

[7] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[8] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

[9] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[10] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[11] MANAGED SERVICES (Fully Managed Operations Model)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has financial or technical gaps requiring full operational support. Mobileum delivers managed roaming, fraud, and security operations, reducing capex while maintaining enterprise-grade capability. Key KPI: Capex -40%.

operators.mobileum_services_text:
[1] STEERING OF ROAMING (SoR)
    -> Category: Roaming Management. High outbound/inbound/business-travel volumes identified. Mobileum AI-powered SoR optimises partner selection, reduces roaming costs, and increases revenue from roaming agreements. Key KPI: Roaming Revenue +15-25%.

[2] ROAMING CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Roaming Management. Strong roaming activity signals upsell opportunity. Targeted pre-trip alerts, roaming packs, and loyalty campaigns convert outbound subscribers into incremental revenue. Key KPI: Roaming Data Revenue +20%.

[3] ROAMING DNA (DPI-powered QoE Management)
    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[7] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

[8] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[9] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[10] SaaS PLATFORM (Cloud-Based Active Intelligence)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has digital maturity and strong financials. Mobileum cloud SaaS delivers rapid time-to-value for roaming analytics, fraud management, and security with minimal infrastructure overhead. Key KPI: Deployment Time -60%.

    -> Category: Roaming Management. Strong roaming activity signals upsell opportunity. Targeted pre-trip alerts, roaming packs, and loyalty campaigns convert outbound subscribers into incremental revenue. Key KPI: Roaming Data Revenue +20%.

    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has financial or technical gaps requiring full operational support. Mobileum delivers managed roaming, fraud, and security operations, reducing capex while maintaining enterprise-grade capability. Key KPI: Capex -40%.

operators.mobileum_services_text:
[1] STEERING OF ROAMING (SoR)
    -> Category: Roaming Management. High outbound/inbound/business-travel volumes identified. Mobileum AI-powered SoR optimises partner selection, reduces roaming costs, and increases revenue from roaming agreements. Key KPI: Roaming Revenue +15-25%.

[2] ROAMING CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Roaming Management. Strong roaming activity signals upsell opportunity. Targeted pre-trip alerts, roaming packs, and loyalty campaigns convert outbound subscribers into incremental revenue. Key KPI: Roaming Data Revenue +20%.

[3] ROAMING DNA (DPI-powered QoE Management)
    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[7] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

[8] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[9] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[10] SaaS PLATFORM (Cloud-Based Active Intelligence)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has digital maturity and strong financials. Mobileum cloud SaaS delivers rapid time-to-value for roaming analytics, fraud management, and security with minimal infrastructure overhead. Key KPI: Deployment Time -60%.

operators.mobileum_services_text:
[1] STEERING OF ROAMING (SoR)
    -> Category: Roaming Management. High outbound/inbound/business-travel volumes identified. Mobileum AI-powered SoR optimises partner selection, reduces roaming costs, and increases revenue from roaming agreements. Key KPI: Roaming Revenue +15-25%.

[2] ROAMING CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Roaming Management. Strong roaming activity signals upsell opportunity. Targeted pre-trip alerts, roaming packs, and loyalty campaigns convert outbound subscribers into incremental revenue. Key KPI: Roaming Data Revenue +20%.

[3] ROAMING DNA (DPI-powered QoE Management)
    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[7] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

[8] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[9] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[10] SaaS PLATFORM (Cloud-Based Active Intelligence)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has digital maturity and strong financials. Mobileum cloud SaaS delivers rapid time-to-value for roaming analytics, fraud management, and security with minimal infrastructure overhead. Key KPI: Deployment Time -60%.

operators.mobileum_services_text:
[1] STEERING OF ROAMING (SoR)
    -> Category: Roaming Management. High outbound/inbound/business-travel volumes identified. Mobileum AI-powered SoR optimises partner selection, reduces roaming costs, and increases revenue from roaming agreements. Key KPI: Roaming Revenue +15-25%.

[2] ROAMING CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Roaming Management. Strong roaming activity signals upsell opportunity. Targeted pre-trip alerts, roaming packs, and loyalty campaigns convert outbound subscribers into incremental revenue. Key KPI: Roaming Data Revenue +20%.

[3] ROAMING DNA (DPI-powered QoE Management)
    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] REVENUE & PROVISIONING ASSURANCE
    -> Category: Risk Management. Profitability pressure, flat/declining ARPU, or weak financials identified. Mobileum detects billing errors, provisioning mismatches, and service leakage to protect and recover margins. Key KPI: Revenue Recovery +2-5% of total revenue.

[7] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[8] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

[9] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[10] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[11] SaaS PLATFORM (Cloud-Based Active Intelligence)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has digital maturity and strong financials. Mobileum cloud SaaS delivers rapid time-to-value for roaming analytics, fraud management, and security with minimal infrastructure overhead. Key KPI: Deployment Time -60%.

    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[7] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

[8] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[9] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[10] SaaS PLATFORM (Cloud-Based Active Intelligence)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has digital maturity and strong financials. Mobileum cloud SaaS delivers rapid time-to-value for roaming analytics, fraud management, and security with minimal infrastructure overhead. Key KPI: Deployment Time -60%.

    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[7] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

[8] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[9] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[10] SaaS PLATFORM (Cloud-Based Active Intelligence)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has digital maturity and strong financials. Mobileum cloud SaaS delivers rapid time-to-value for roaming analytics, fraud management, and security with minimal infrastructure overhead. Key KPI: Deployment Time -60%.

[1] STEERING OF ROAMING (SoR)
    -> Category: Roaming Management. High outbound/inbound/business-travel volumes identified. Mobileum AI-powered SoR optimises partner selection, reduces roaming costs, and increases revenue from roaming agreements. Key KPI: Roaming Revenue +15-25%.

[2] ROAMING CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Roaming Management. Strong roaming activity signals upsell opportunity. Targeted pre-trip alerts, roaming packs, and loyalty campaigns convert outbound subscribers into incremental revenue. Key KPI: Roaming Data Revenue +20%.

[3] ROAMING DNA (DPI-powered QoE Management)
    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[7] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

[8] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[9] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[10] SaaS PLATFORM (Cloud-Based Active Intelligence)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has digital maturity and strong financials. Mobileum cloud SaaS delivers rapid time-to-value for roaming analytics, fraud management, and security with minimal infrastructure overhead. Key KPI: Deployment Time -60%.

    -> Category: Roaming Management. High outbound/inbound/business-travel volumes identified. Mobileum AI-powered SoR optimises partner selection, reduces roaming costs, and increases revenue from roaming agreements. Key KPI: Roaming Revenue +15-25%.

[2] ROAMING CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Roaming Management. Strong roaming activity signals upsell opportunity. Targeted pre-trip alerts, roaming packs, and loyalty campaigns convert outbound subscribers into incremental revenue. Key KPI: Roaming Data Revenue +20%.

[3] ROAMING DNA (DPI-powered QoE Management)
    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[7] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

[8] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[9] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[10] SaaS PLATFORM (Cloud-Based Active Intelligence)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has digital maturity and strong financials. Mobileum cloud SaaS delivers rapid time-to-value for roaming analytics, fraud management, and security with minimal infrastructure overhead. Key KPI: Deployment Time -60%.

operators.mobileum_services_text:
[1] STEERING OF ROAMING (SoR)
    -> Category: Roaming Management. High outbound/inbound/business-travel volumes identified. Mobileum AI-powered SoR optimises partner selection, reduces roaming costs, and increases revenue from roaming agreements. Key KPI: Roaming Revenue +15-25%.

[2] ROAMING CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Roaming Management. Strong roaming activity signals upsell opportunity. Targeted pre-trip alerts, roaming packs, and loyalty campaigns convert outbound subscribers into incremental revenue. Key KPI: Roaming Data Revenue +20%.

[3] ROAMING DNA (DPI-powered QoE Management)
    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[7] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

[8] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[9] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[10] SaaS PLATFORM (Cloud-Based Active Intelligence)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has digital maturity and strong financials. Mobileum cloud SaaS delivers rapid time-to-value for roaming analytics, fraud management, and security with minimal infrastructure overhead. Key KPI: Deployment Time -60%.

operators.mobileum_services_text:
[1] STEERING OF ROAMING (SoR)
    -> Category: Roaming Management. High outbound/inbound/business-travel volumes identified. Mobileum AI-powered SoR optimises partner selection, reduces roaming costs, and increases revenue from roaming agreements. Key KPI: Roaming Revenue +15-25%.

[2] ROAMING CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Roaming Management. Strong roaming activity signals upsell opportunity. Targeted pre-trip alerts, roaming packs, and loyalty campaigns convert outbound subscribers into incremental revenue. Key KPI: Roaming Data Revenue +20%.

[3] ROAMING DNA (DPI-powered QoE Management)
    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] REVENUE & PROVISIONING ASSURANCE
    -> Category: Risk Management. Profitability pressure, flat/declining ARPU, or weak financials identified. Mobileum detects billing errors, provisioning mismatches, and service leakage to protect and recover margins. Key KPI: Revenue Recovery +2-5% of total revenue.

[6] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[7] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[8] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[9] MANAGED SERVICES (Fully Managed Operations Model)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has financial or technical gaps requiring full operational support. Mobileum delivers managed roaming, fraud, and security operations, reducing capex while maintaining enterprise-grade capability. Key KPI: Capex -40%.

    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] REVENUE & PROVISIONING ASSURANCE
    -> Category: Risk Management. Profitability pressure, flat/declining ARPU, or weak financials identified. Mobileum detects billing errors, provisioning mismatches, and service leakage to protect and recover margins. Key KPI: Revenue Recovery +2-5% of total revenue.

    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[8] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[10] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[11] SaaS PLATFORM (Cloud-Based Active Intelligence)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has digital maturity and strong financials. Mobileum cloud SaaS delivers rapid time-to-value for roaming analytics, fraud management, and security with minimal infrastructure overhead. Key KPI: Deployment Time -60%.

operators.mobileum_services_text:
[1] STEERING OF ROAMING (SoR)
    -> Category: Roaming Management. High outbound/inbound/business-travel volumes identified. Mobileum AI-powered SoR optimises partner selection, reduces roaming costs, and increases revenue from roaming agreements. Key KPI: Roaming Revenue +15-25%.

[2] ROAMING CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Roaming Management. Strong roaming activity signals upsell opportunity. Targeted pre-trip alerts, roaming packs, and loyalty campaigns convert outbound subscribers into incremental revenue. Key KPI: Roaming Data Revenue +20%.

[3] ROAMING DNA (DPI-powered QoE Management)
    -> Category: Roaming Experience Management. With active inbound/outbound traffic, QoE monitoring is critical. DPI-powered analytics deliver 360-degree network performance visibility, subscriber-level QoE, and optimal partner steering. Key KPI: QoE Score +25%.

[4] 5G ENABLEMENT & LTE/5G ACTIVE TESTING
    -> Category: Technology Enablement. 5G coverage gaps or technology gaps identified in BU analysis. Mobileum provides real-time active testing, VoLTE/VoNR validation, and network performance benchmarking to accelerate secure 5G deployment. Key KPI: 5G Rollout Acceleration -30% time.

[5] RAID 9 - AI-POWERED FRAUD MANAGEMENT
    -> Category: Risk Management. OTT substitution pressure, IDD bypass risk, and churn signals indicate revenue leakage. RAID 9 detects bypass fraud, flash calls, SIM-box fraud, IRSF, and roaming fraud in real time using AI and ML adaptive rules. Key KPI: Fraud Loss Reduction -60%.

[6] SIGNALLING SECURITY FIREWALL (SS7/Diameter/5G SCP)
    -> Category: Network Security. Technology gaps and infrastructure needs expose operator to signalling attacks. Mobileum #1-ranked Signalling Firewall protects against location tracking, call interception, and DDoS across SS7, Diameter, and 5G SCP. Key KPI: Attack Detection Rate 99.9%.

[7] CUSTOMER INTELLIGENCE & SUBSCRIBER ANALYTICS
    -> Category: Active Intelligence Platform. Churn risk, retention gaps, and OTT substitution pressure identified. Active Intelligence Platform converts network data into personalised retention actions and ARPU upsell opportunities. Key KPI: Churn Reduction -15-25%.

[8] ROAMING HUB & IPX INTERCONNECT SERVICES
    -> Category: Interconnect and Wholesale. Operator needs roaming expansion or 5G interoperability. Mobileum enables IPX routing, GRX/IPX migration, and wholesale roaming enablement to extend reach and monetise international traffic. Key KPI: Interconnect Cost -15%.

[9] ACTIVE ROAMING TESTING & NETWORK ASSURANCE (Universal)
    -> Category: Testing and Assurance. Universal product applied to all operators regardless of size or market maturity. Real-device voice/data/SMS testing on home and partner networks, automated fault detection, and QoS benchmarking. Key KPI: OpEx Reduction -20%.

[10] SaaS PLATFORM (Cloud-Based Active Intelligence)
    -> Category: Delivery Model. Operator has digital maturity and strong financials. Mobileum cloud SaaS delivers rapid time-to-value for roaming analytics, fraud management, and security with minimal infrastructure overhead. Key KPI: Deployment Time -60%.
